teacher_info.intro: My name is Maryam and apart from English, I also speak Turkish and Persian. I am passionate about learning and teaching languages because I believe learning a new language is the key to understanding a new culture. Being well-traveled and exposed to different cultures has helped me successfully teach languages to students from other countries. Your personal interests will form the topics for our lessons together. During our conversations, I will listen carefully to you and advise you of the adjustments you may need to make to your pronunciation, lexical, or grammatical choices in order to help you become an articulate and coherent speaker.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have a CELTA diploma -- Certificate in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages -- from the University of Cambridge and 20 years of experience teaching English in both face-to-face and online classes. 
I teach any level of English between beginner and advanced, helping my students to hone each and every one of the four skills-- reading, listening, speaking, and writing. I truly enjoy teaching and helping people achieve their language learning goals.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My students' needs and preferences are the basis of my lesson planning and I believe that if we collaborate together and find out about the language areas and skills that we need to focus on, then we can agree on goals. Whether your goal is to improve your general English or acquire a certain score in IELTS, TOEFL, etc., I will help you achieve it through tailor-made lessons for you.
In your lessons with me, your participation in the class will be at the highest of levels and additionally, you will be actively involved in the lessons through speaking practices. To help you achieve optimal success - at the end of each session, I will always provide you with constructive feedback.

course_info.trial_description: During a trial lesson, I will asses student's level of English language knowledge and will identify their strength and weakness points. Then I and the learner will discuss which areas of the language and which skills need to be focused on and decide on objectives and goals. Finally I will explain how I will help them achieve the mentioned objectives and goals.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description: The main focus of this lesson is improving students' general knowledge of the English language by focusing on four skills including speaking, writing, reading, and listening. The students can choose to concentrate on one particular skill or more, based on their needs and preferences.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation practice
pro_course_detail.description:
conversation sessions will be helpful and fun lessons with the topics of your interests and preferences. we can have open conversation lessons in which the conversation will take place without previous planning or any special material, just like conversation in real life.
We can also have structured conversation sessions based around a previously selected topic, featuring an article to prompt and drive the conversation. I can include teaching vocabulary and grammatical features present in the article if needed.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar structures , vocabulary
pro_course_detail.description: I teach grammatical structures and vocabulary in a communicative and practicable way and include enough controlled and the freer practice of the already learnt items in each session. My students use the learnt grammar or vocabulary items in speaking or writing practices in order to produce the language of their own at each lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: English for beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
You can start to learn English with me at any age you are, even if you are an absolute beginner.
I know how to plan easy and understandable lessons for you based on what your goal is for learning English.

teacher_info.intro: I am a native Turkish speaker. I am a student at a med school in İstanbul. I am looking for students learning Turkish (for all levels) and English (beginner,elemantary and pre-intermediate). If you have any question, please feel free to ask.
teacher_info.introduction:
Hello! 
I am a native Turkish speaker. I am a university student at a medical faculty in İstanbul. I am here to teach you Turkish. I can help all level Turkish learners from A1 (Beginner) to C1(Advanced). 

Services: 
.Regular lesson plan 
.Speaking lessons 

Before applying any of my lessons: 

When you contact me, I will ask you to take a free Turkish level test, so I can organize lessons for you. In addition to this, I will ask you to introduce yourself, so I can add special materials according to your likes or I can change the way lessons will be taught. 

Before you lessons: 

Before at each lesson, I will send you some documents that I am going to teach you from. There could be some tasks for you to do before lessons or not. During lessons: We will have 5 different parts: Vocublary, Grammar, Reading, Exercises and Activity. Lessons will not only contain information. You will could see somethiing from Turkish culture or a funny Turkish story or anything (video, pic...) I am not a comedian, I cannot make you laugh a lot. Furthermore I am good at teaching but I am not really funny :D. However, I will try my best at this area, too. 

After lessons: 

After each lesson, I will send you exercises or a quiz over Edmodo or Google Form. You will have some easy question to remind you our lesson. Not to make you bored, I will try to keep exercises and quizzes short. 

You can ask me any question you have, please feel free to ask :) 

This my my regular plan for lessons. However, if you are A2 (Elemantary), B1(Pre-intermediate), B1+ (Intermadiate), B2 (Upper-int) or C1 (advanced) we can follow an other stuructre. My personal suggestion is that if you are not beginner, you should talk. So, we can choose a topic for those level and make a conversation with about that topic. 

Finally, if you have any suggestion about lessons or anything, feedbacks are welcomed.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I graduated from English Language Teaching in Marmara University, Istanbul. I worked for a few years in a private school. Since 2013, I have taught in one of the universities in Turkey. Personally, I wouldn't only think about experience when it comes to finding a good teacher. I have seen many naive teachers who do a great job or vice versa. I guess good teaching is some sort of agreement between the personality and the requirements of the job of teaching.  As a teacher, I believe my strengths would be to anticipate well what difficulties a student may have through the process of learning a language and to be able to simplify complicated points. You can say better after taking classes...
teacher_info.teaching_style:
If communication is your main goal, we don't have to speak a common language. But if you want to have a grammar-based class (due to your personality or aims), then speaking a COMMON LANGUAGE would be my preference. For communication, my method is little grammar and much practice. For other purposes (exams or writing), you can learn very subtle grammar points with me. My classes will always be shaped around your needs. Also, I will always be guiding you about how to learn a language for a specific purpose. For the materials, we can ascertain their inclusion after trial classes.
I have experience of teaching to people who want to learn a language for business or for common exams.

I was always interested to interact with my mom's and other relatives' students and loved seeing how big of a difference teachers can make. Öğretmen dolu bir ailede büyüdüm ve küçükken annemin öğrencileriyle vakit geçirmek hep çok ilgimi çekti. Bu sayede öğretmenlerin öğrencilerin hayatlarına etkilerini gözlemledim. Başkalarına ders vermek de benim için doğal bir süreç olarak başladı.

pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking for a fun, relaxed, and engaging way to practice your English? Do you want to improve your fluency, gain confidence, and speak more naturally? If so, regardless of your English level, my "Free English Conversation" lesson is perfect for you!

**What is this lesson about?**

This is a free conversation lesson where you can practice speaking English in a comfortable and supportive environment on any topic you like. Sometimes, we may use materials like videos or articles to spark real, meaningful conversations that help you express yourself better.

**How will this lesson help you?**

By joining my Free English Conversation lesson, you will:
✅ Improve your fluency and pronunciation
✅ Learn new words and phrases in a natural way
✅ Gain confidence in speaking English
✅ Develop better listening skills
✅ Learn about different cultures and perspectives
✅ Get personalized feedback and tips to improve your speaking

**How to Prepare for the Lesson**

You don’t need to prepare anything! Just bring yourself, a willingness to talk, and maybe a cup of coffee or tea. However, if you have a topic in mind, feel free to share it with me before our lesson.

**Final Words**

Speaking English fluently is not about memorizing grammar rules—it’s about practice! The more you speak, the more confident you’ll become.

Let’s have an engaging conversation and take your English to the next level!

See you! 😊

teacher_info.teaching_style:
Everybody has a passion, right? And mine is traveling, learning new cultures and trying to understand all of them in their own native languages, and sharing and teaching what I know. My all-the-time motivation was that it is useless to take knowledge to the grave without sharing it.

So what are we going to do? In the process of learning a language, together we will explore the language, try to understand the culture and language structure. What are you waiting for? Let’s get started.

course_info.trial_description:
🇺🇲 How about taking a step to learn Turkish or Spanish ? In this trial lesson we will get to know each other, I will understand your needs, goals and we will design further course of learning! Looking forward seeing you!

In our trial lesson, I promise to teach you the golden rule and the key to learning these languages. In fact, it's not as hard as it sounds, let's explore the darkness together and remember that sunny days await you! 

🇪🇸 ¿Qué tal dar un paso para aprender turco o ingles? ¡En esta lección de prueba nos conoceremos, entenderemos sus necesidades, objetivos y diseñaremos un curso de aprendizaje adicional! ¡Deseando verte!

En nuestra lección de prueba, prometo enseñarte la regla de oro y la clave para aprender los idiomas. De hecho, no es tan difícil como parece, ¡exploremos juntos la oscuridad y recuerda que te esperan días soleados! 

🇹🇷ispanyolca veya İngilizce öğrenmek için bir adım atmaya ne dersin? Bu deneme dersimizde birbirimizi daha da yakından tanıyacağız, ihtiyaçlarını, hedeflerini anlayacağım ve daha üst düzey bir öğrenim rotasını birlikte tasarlayacağız! Seni görmeyi sabırsızlıkla bekliyorum!

Deneme dersimizde, size bu dilleri öğrenmenin altın kuralını ve anahtarını vereceğime ve öğreteceğime söz veriyorum. Aslında bu sanıldığı kadar da zor değil, gel o karanlık olarak gördüğün yeri beraber keşfedelim ve unutma güneşli günler seni bekliyor!

pro_course_detail.title: Let's get our hands dirty - How to construct a sentence in Turkish?
pro_course_detail.description:
🇺🇲 If you want to get a little bit of taste of the Turkish language but say you have no idea where and how to start, this course is for you.

After first explaining the difference of Turkish from other languages and its language family, we travel deeper together, and we will be improving your Turkish by using different materials, methods, teaching tools, and etc.

🇪🇸 Si quieres iniciarte un poco en la lengua turca pero dices que no tienes ni idea de por dónde y cómo empezar, este curso es para ti.

Después de explicar y descubrir primero la diferencia entre el turco y otros idiomas y su familia lingüística, profundizaremos juntos y mejoraremos su turco utilizando diferentes materiales, métodos, herramientas de enseñanza, etc.

pro_course_detail.title: Turkish pronunciation and speaking - How to speak like a native?
pro_course_detail.description:
🇺🇲 Students often hesitate about pronunciation and do not want to go over this fear, but there is nothing to worry about. Because every letter in Turkish has a sound and this sound does not change. In the context of this rule, we will read books together, we will listen to music and sing together, and we will see our mistakes when we make sentences together and we will improve ourselves very, very much. 

Unfortunately there is no magic wand, but isn't life itself magic? Let's face our fears and conquer them!

🇪🇸A menudo, los alumnos dudan sobre la pronunciación y no quieren pasar ese miedo, pero no hay nada de qué preocuparse. Porque cada letra en turco tiene un sonido y este sonido no cambia. En el contexto de esta regla, leeremos libros juntos, escucharemos música y cantaremos juntos, y veremos nuestros errores cuando hagamos frases juntos y mejoraremos mucho, muchísimo. 

Por desgracia, no hay varita mágica, pero ¿acaso no es mágica la vida misma? ¡Enfrentémonos a nuestros miedos y venzámoslos!

pro_course_detail.title: Modal verbs in Turkish language - Do you want or Can you?
pro_course_detail.description:
🇺🇲 Scientific research shows that modal verbs make up 35% of everyday spoken dialog. Thanks to modal verbs, we can express topics ranging from wanting something, or being able to do something, to a future event. 

In this course, instead of getting lost in boring grammar, let's prepare you with the necessary equipment to speak and feel freer in both writing and speaking! In this course, you will also be able to express yourself more freely in the future by reinforcing this rule in every sentence we write under the main topic of how to construct sentences in Turkish. 

🇪🇸 Las investigaciones científicas demuestran que los verbos modales constituyen el 35% del diálogo oral cotidiano. Gracias a los verbos modales, podemos expresar temas que van desde querer algo o poder hacer algo hasta un acontecimiento futuro. 

En este curso, en lugar de perderte en la aburrida gramática, vamos a prepararte con el equipo necesario para hablar y sentirte más libre tanto al escribir como al hablar. En este curso, también podrás expresarte más libremente en el futuro reforzando esta regla en cada frase que escribamos bajo el tema principal de cómo construir frases en turco.

pro_course_detail.title: İngilizce cümle nasıl kurulur - ¿Cómo construir una frase en inglés?
pro_course_detail.description:
🇹🇷 İngilizceyi biraz olsun tatmak istiyor ama nereden ve nasıl başlayacağımı bilmiyorum diyorsanız bu kurs tam size göre.

Önce İngilizcenin diğer dillerden farkını ve dil ailesini anlattıktan sonra birlikte daha derinlere iniyor, farklı materyaller, yöntemler, öğretim araçları vb. kullanarak İngilizcenizi geliştiriyor olacağız.

🇪🇸 Si quieres iniciarte un poco en la lengua Ingles pero dices que no tienes ni idea de por dónde y cómo empezar, este curso es para ti.

Después de explicar y descubrir primero la diferencia entre el ingles y otros idiomas y su familia lingüística, profundizaremos juntos y mejoraremos su ingles utilizando diferentes materiales, métodos, herramientas de enseñanza, etc.

pro_course_detail.title: İngilizce telaffuz ve konuşma - Anadili gibi İngilizce nasıl konuşulur? | Pronunciación y expresión oral en inglés - ¿Cómo hablar inglés como un nativo?
pro_course_detail.description:
🇹🇷 Öğrenciler genellikle telaffuz konusunda tereddüt eder ve bu korkunun üzerine gitmek istemezler ancak endişelenecek bir şey yoktur. Genel kurallar bağlamında birlikte kitap okuyacağız, birlikte müzik dinleyip şarkı söyleyeceğiz ve birlikte cümle kurduğumuzda hatalarımızı göreceğiz ve kendimizi çok ama çok geliştireceğiz. 

Maalesef sihirli bir değnek yok ama hayatın kendisi sihirli değil mi? Hadi korkularımızla yüzleşelim ve onları yenelim!

🇪🇸 Los alumnos suelen tener dudas sobre la pronunciación y no quieren superar este miedo, pero no hay de qué preocuparse. Por regla general, leeremos libros juntos, escucharemos música y cantaremos juntos y cuando hagamos frases juntos veremos nuestros errores y mejoraremos muchísimo. 

Por desgracia, no existe una varita mágica, pero ¿acaso no es mágica la vida misma? ¡Enfrentémonos a nuestros miedos y venzámoslos!

pro_course_detail.title: İngilizce dilinde modal fiiller - İstiyor musunuz yoksa Yapabilir misiniz? | Los verbos modales en Ingles - ¿Quieres o puedes?
pro_course_detail.description:
🇹🇷 Bilimsel araştırmalar, kip fiillerin günlük konuşma dilinin %35'ını oluşturduğunu göstermektedir. Modal fiiller sayesinde, bir şeyi istemekten veya bir şeyi yapabilmeye, gelecekteki bir olaya kadar çeşitli konuları ifade edebiliriz. Bu kursta sıkıcı dilbilgisi içinde kaybolmak yerine sizi konuşmak için gerekli donanımla hazırlayalım ve hem yazarken hem de konuşurken kendinizi daha özgür hissedin! Bu kursta ayrıca İngilizce cümle nasıl kurulur ana başlığı altında yazdığımız her cümlede bu kuralı pekiştirerek ileride kendinizi daha özgürce ifade edebileceksiniz. 

🇪🇸 Las investigaciones científicas demuestran que los verbos modales constituyen el 35% del diálogo oral cotidiano. Gracias a los verbos modales, podemos expresar temas que van desde querer algo o poder hacer algo hasta un acontecimiento futuro. 

En este curso, en lugar de perderte en la aburrida gramática, vamos a prepararte con el equipo necesario para hablar y sentirte más libre tanto al escribir como al hablar. En este curso, también podrás expresarte más libremente en el futuro reforzando esta regla en cada frase que escribamos bajo el tema principal de cómo construir frases en ingles.
